page.layout: One column of text, with marginal notes in the left margin beside the first lines. Running head and page number at the top. Chapter number and italic title above the text. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: CAP. XXI.

head.i: Utrum eum liceat occidere, qui ali-quem aggreditur, animo tantum mutilandi ?

main_text.p: QUemadmodum in mode-ramine inculpatæ tutelæ non necessario requiritur ut præsens sit mortis periculum; ita non semper opus est, ut proxime immineat periculum mortis; quod sufficiat adesse Covarr, 3. part. Relect. c. quam. vis past.[?]vulneris periculum, aut mutilationis membrorum. Idque verum de jure canonum, quo irregularitatem non incurrit, qui seipsum defendens, adversus mutilare volentem, aggressorem occidit. page.notes: The left-margin note reads "Covarr, / 3. part. / Relect. / c. quam. / vis paft.", set on separate lines; "paft." is transcribed as "past." and is doubtful (possibly "pact."). The catchword "ficerę" is the start of the next page's text ("sufficere"), shown at the lower right. The printed title's "Utrum" and the heading are in italic. The text at the foot of the scan is a digitiser's mark and was left out.
